description:
Build the "manufacturer and product safety" block that every online offer of a non-food product must show in the EU
    (GPSR, Regulation (EU) 2023/988, art. 19), as HTML (French labels) and plain text, ready to paste into a product page.

    Args:
        manufacturer_name: manufacturer's name or trade name.
        manufacturer_postal_address: manufacturer's postal address.
        manufacturer_email: manufacturer's e-mail or electronic contact.
        eu_responsible_name / eu_responsible_postal_address / eu_responsible_email: the EU responsible person, required
            when the manufacturer is established outside the EU.
        product_identification: type, batch or serial number, or another identifier, plus a picture reference if any.
        safety_warnings: warnings and safety information, in French for the French market.
name: generate_gpsr_block
